tools.description: Creates an Entra ID or Okta environment and selects it as this session's current environment.
tools.title: Create mock identity environment

tools.description: Lists environments available to the account and identifies this session's current environment.
tools.title: List mock identity environments

tools.description: Permanently deletes an environment. MCP may omit environmentId to target the session cursor; HTTP always requires it.
tools.title: Delete mock identity environment

tools.description: Updates mutable environment settings through MCP or configures the complete environment document through the self-hosted HTTP control route.
tools.title: Configure mock identity environment

tools.description: Creates users and groups in an environment. MCP may use the session cursor; HTTP always requires an explicit environment.
tools.title: Seed users and groups

tools.description: Registers an OAuth/OIDC client in an explicit or session-selected environment.
tools.title: Create application registration

tools.description: Mints a token, optionally with a deterministic broken-token variant, in the current or named environment.
tools.title: Mint identity token

tools.description: Starts a deterministic Entra or Okta-shaped SCIM provisioning cycle against a validated test target.
tools.title: Run outbound provisioning cycle

tools.description: Creates or replaces an injected behavior at an environment injection point.
tools.title: Set deterministic failure scenario

tools.description: Clears one scenario by id, or all scenarios when scenarioId is omitted.
tools.title: Clear deterministic failure scenarios

tools.description: Returns a filtered page of inbound, outbound, or control traffic for an environment.
tools.title: Get request log

tools.description: Evaluates a deterministic assertion against captured environment traffic.
tools.title: Assert captured requests

tools.description: Applies an Entra or Okta user lifecycle action, including token revocation, in the current or named environment.
tools.title: Simulate provider lifecycle transition

tools.description: Returns issuer, discovery, OAuth/OIDC, JWKS, and SCIM URLs for an environment.
tools.title: Get provider endpoint URLs

tools.description: Selects the environment used when other MCP tools omit environmentId; pass null to clear the session cursor.
tools.title: Select current environment

tools.description: Creates or atomically replaces one environment-local mock MCP server. Bearer Mock Credentials are accepted only in this write operation and are never returned.
tools.title: Create or replace a mock MCP server

tools.description: Lists safe summaries of the mock MCP servers in the current or named environment.
tools.title: List mock MCP servers

tools.description: Returns a mock MCP server definition without bearer credential material or its verifier.
tools.title: Get mock MCP server

tools.description: Deletes a mock MCP server and its revision-bound sessions and application state.
tools.title: Delete mock MCP server

tools.description: Deletes sequence cursors and other application state for one mock MCP server without changing its definition.
tools.title: Reset mock MCP application state

tools.description: Creates or compare-and-swap replaces one environment-local mock LLM server. Strict provider Mock Credentials are accepted only in this write operation and are never returned.
tools.title: Create or replace a mock LLM server

tools.description: Lists safe summaries of the mock LLM server definitions in the current or named environment.
tools.title: List mock LLM servers

tools.description: Returns a mock LLM server definition without provider Mock Credentials or their verifiers.
tools.title: Get mock LLM server

tools.description: Deletes one mock LLM server definition only when expectedRevision still matches. This management-only slice has no conversation, response-plan, or evaluator-state rows.
tools.title: Delete mock LLM server
